'''Valdon Krasul''' was a [[Cathar/Legends|Cathar]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who was the son of [[Zorin Krasul]], the [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Anaxes/Legends|Anaxes]] in the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Senate]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. Valdon and his brother, [[Riv Krasul|Riv]], were the children of Zorin and his wife [[Ondia Krasul]].<ref name="FW" />
